# Turn an Etsy statement into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Etsy statement to journal converter: checks every row, books gross sales, listing and transaction fees, ads, shipping labels, refunds and bank deposits separately by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
